option.name: Tweaks
option.description: The tweaks' code: the tweaks below work while this is enabled.

option.name: Skip intro
option.description: Boots straight to the main menu: no notice screens, intro movie or title screen (the studio logo still shows).

option.name: Fast menus
option.description: Skips menu transitions: panels sliding in and out, and camera moves such as the zoom from the main menu. Idle animations and matches are unchanged.

option.name: All stadiums fast-paced
option.description: Every pitch plays like the fast, dry ones such as Bowser Stadium (the game's DryTerrain surface).

option.name: No Mega Strikes with controllers
option.description: Blocking a Mega Strike needs a Wii Remote's pointer. While a controller plays (a gamepad or the keyboard in Strikers Recharged, a GameCube controller with the GameCube controllers pack), matches have Mega Strikes off for both sides.

option.name: Unlock everything
option.description: All characters, stadiums and cheats, through the game's own unlock-all switch. The save isn't changed: turn it off to see your own progress.

option.name: Win by 2
option.description: First-to-X goal matches: tied one goal short of the target, the target moves up, so the winner has to be 2 goals ahead.

option.name: Fix the NK bug
option.description: A deke or teleport through the goalie that gets cut short (Boo deking into his own Kritter, Dry Bones teleporting behind the goal) no longer leaves every shot passing through Kritter for the rest of the match.

option.name: Blue Peach against red teams
option.description: Peach wears her blue kit against red captains (Mario, Bowser, Bowser Jr., Petey, Daisy, Diddy Kong), so the teams are easy to tell apart.

option.name: Shot counter on the results screen
option.description: The Mega Strike goals / shots row shows white and yellow shots / red and orange shots instead.
